audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows contradicted their own why text: Level 2 read Ornn while whys[1] says 'Still even at 2'; Levels 4-5 and Level 6 read Skill while whys[3]/[4] describe Ornn punishing him and winning the all-in; first item read Ornn while whys[5] calls it an even window; 2+ items read Ornn while whys[6] says Sylas reclaims the duel.
audit.why: The prose read matches the kit and the packet chart on all five. Sylas's power curve is two dashes plus a heal that scale with AP items, so the 4-6 window where both his dashes are on 12-13s cooldowns belongs to Ornn and the two-item window does not.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill, Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Skill, Sylas across both layers with matching ratings, as one atomic pair-group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 said only 'Sylas's ultimate changes the math' — the single biggest consideration in the matchup was left unstated in the full layer, and no cooldowns appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30s and steals Ornn's ultimate outright. That both threatens Ornn's R and creates a real, trackable window: with Hijack down, Call of the Forge God is safe to spend. The rank-3 cooldown of 30s is a genuine mid-game power shift.
audit.corrected: Hijack named and timed in phases[4].why and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two hard errors. (a) Abscond/Abduct was described everywhere as 'His dash + stun (recast pull)' — there is no stun, and the recast pulls Sylas to the enemy, not the enemy to Sylas. (b) Content text repeatedly calls Chain Lash (Q) a 'drain' and attributes his sustain to it; the heal is Kingslayer (W).
audit.why: Riot text, E: 'Sylas dashes to a location. Sylas can recast the ability to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits.' Riot text, W: 'Sylas lunges at an enemy with magical force dealing damage and healing himself against enemy champions.' Telling an Ornn player to fear a stun that does not exist changes how they position for no reason, and blaming the wrong ability for his sustain misdirects the anti-heal timing.
audit.corrected: Corrected in dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, whys[1] and report[8].

audit.whatIsWrong: Sylas has two dashes — Abscond and the Kingslayer lunge — and Ornn's Q grounds. The page never connected them.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture carries 'grounding: shuts off enemy dashes' and both of Sylas's mobility tools carry the dash flag. Grounding him is what turns a Sylas who can enter and leave at will into a target for the E-into-pillar knock-up. This is the highest-value unstated interaction in the matchup.
audit.corrected: Stated in tldr, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was present but generic and unattributed.
audit.why: The flagged missing interaction is Kingslayer, a 12s-at-rank-1 dash that heals off champions — it heals every trade, not just extended ones, so Grievous Wounds is a timing decision rather than a situational buy.
audit.corrected: report[8] now names Kingslayer and sets the buy by second item; phases[6].why states the heal as the reason he reclaims the duel.

edits.before: Bait his key tool — brittle-proc him on the Abscond / Abduct cooldown and out-item the lane. Ornn wins the Abscond / Abduct cooldown windows.
edits.after: Your Q grounds both his dashes — Abscond and the Kingslayer lunge. Land it and he cannot enter or leave, so E off the pillar and Brittle him.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Abscond / Abduct's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Both his dashes are down for 12-13s at rank 1 after a trade. That is your window: Q the pillar behind him, E into it, then Brittle.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Sylas's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Hijack steals your ultimate outright — 80s at rank 1, 30s at rank 3. Spend Call of the Forge God only when his R is down, and then it is your all-in.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Sylas carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Sylas reclaims the duel: Kingslayer heals him through your chip and two dashes kite your 450-range E. Buy Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 13s dash, and the recast pulls him to you — it does not stun. Your Q grounds it.

edits.before: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. When it is down — W-brittle + E knockup.
edits.after: Abscond is a dash whose recast pulls Sylas to you — there is no stun. Your Q grounds it, and Kingslayer's lunge too.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — His dash + stun (recast pull). Bait it, then commit. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond: 13s at rank 1 — a dash whose recast pulls him in, not a stun, and your Q grounds it. - Kingslayer: 12s at rank 1, a second dash and his heal. - Hijack: 80s at rank 1, 30s at rank 3 — he steals your R.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (forge-upgradeable), then Sunfire Aegis; boots Mercury's Treads. Add anti-heal (Thornmail component early) — his healing fights your grind.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pot. Core: Iceborn Gauntlet  (forge-upgradeable), then Sunfire Aegis; boots Mercury's Treads. Kingslayer heals him every trade — get Grievous Wounds by your second item.

edits.before: Still even at 2 — you're mana-starved without your W shield online and his Q drain pokes safely, so concede and last-hit.
edits.after: Still even at 2 — Chain Lash pokes you safely from 775 range and Kingslayer, his actual heal, is not ranked yet.

notes: The 'Q drain' error survives in whys[2], whys[5], whys[6], spikes[0], spikes[2], spikes[3], early, mid, late and wants.foe[0] — Chain Lash does no healing; Kingslayer does. I corrected the instances I could rewrite inside the length band and in the full layer; the remaining content strings need a champion-level find-and-replace of 'Q drain' / 'Q/W drain-heal' that is safer done in one pass than piecemeal. Flagging rather than half-fixing. UNVERIFIED and left alone: the recurring 'W's unstoppable shield' claim — Riot's Bellows Breath text mentions no shield and no unstoppable, so wants.you[1] and spikes[0] may be asserting a mechanic that does not exist; I did not repeat it.
